IN PHOTOS: A dense layer of toxic smog blankets the capital’s skyline as a continuing fire at the Navotas sanitary landfill worsens air quality across Metro Manila. Captured on April 27, 2026, the aerial scene shows heavy particulate haze drifting over residential areas and major roads, reducing visibility and heightening health concerns for millions of residents.

Meanwhile, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has ordered all sanitary landfill operators to submit contingency plans for emergency response, nearly two weeks after the blaze at the Navotas site began.

📸: Edd Castro
